Sindy Huang website — October 20, 2026

WINDOWS
1. Right-click the ZIP and choose Extract All.
2. Open the extracted sindy-website folder.
3. Double-click Start Website.cmd. A browser opens automatically.
4. Keep the console window open; close it to stop the server.

The launcher uses Windows PowerShell and listens only on this computer (127.0.0.1). It installs nothing and does not change execution policy. It has not been run on Windows in this session.

You can also open index.html directly for the portfolio pages.

All pages, images, fonts, styles and scripts are included. External project and social links still need internet. Jobs-board progress is stored in each browser, not synced between computers or website addresses.
